What to verify: Every purchase has one internal order ID and expected amount/currency
Exception trigger: Order has no stable ID or expected total

What to verify: Every provider attempt links to one order and payment method
Exception trigger: Provider reference is missing or reused
Customer update: Tell customer payment is being checked
Next action: Locate the attempt before asking for another payment

What to verify: Reference, final status, amount, currency and merchant account match the order
Evidence to retain: Verification response or authenticated event reference
Customer update: Do not call it paid; tell customer not to retry while checking
Next action: Verify with provider and open an exception

What to verify: Use the current provider signature scheme before trusting the payload
Evidence to retain: Event ID, signature result, received timestamp
Customer update: No customer message unless the order is affected
Next action: Reject untrusted event and log safely

What to verify: Repeated or retried events do not duplicate fulfilment, refunds or ledger entries
Exception trigger: Same event/reference processed more than once
Next action: Return safe acknowledgement and inspect the existing result

What to verify: Verified payment creates one fulfilment task; fulfilment is recorded separately
Exception trigger: Verified payment has no fulfilment result
Customer update: Confirm payment and explain fulfilment delay
Next action: Retry safely or assign support/operations owner

What to verify: Successful transactions are linked to provider settlement ID, currency and destination
Exception trigger: Expected transaction is missing, flagged or failed
Customer update: Explain that payment is confirmed but payout is still being checked only if relevant
Next action: Check settlement detail and provider notice

What to verify: Order ID, provider reference and settlement batch match by amount and currency
Evidence to retain: Reconciliation row and bank credit reference
Customer update: Update customer only if their order is affected
Next action: Assign owner, amount, next action and due time

What to verify: Reason, amount, eligibility, prior refunds and approver are recorded
Next action: Approve, decline or request missing information

What to verify: Store refund reference and distinguish pending, processing, needs-attention, processed and failed where supported
Exception trigger: Refund needs attention, failed or exceeds provider window
Customer update: State the provider status and current published window
Next action: Resolve missing details or escalate with provider

What to verify: Record received time, provider deadline, business-day rules and responsible person
Customer update: Acknowledge only what is known; request evidence if needed
Next action: Assign case owner and evidence deadline

What to verify: Order terms, invoice, delivery evidence, customer communication and policy are traceable
Exception trigger: Evidence missing or deadline at risk
Customer update: Tell customer the case is under review if appropriate
Next action: Submit through provider channel before deadline

What to verify: Do not promise settlement, fulfilment or refund receipt before it is confirmed
Exception trigger: Customer update is overdue or contradicts provider state
Customer update: Give precise status and next update time
Next action: Correct the message and assign follow-up

What to verify: Record payment, fee, settlement, refund, reversal and dispute adjustments separately
Exception trigger: Original transaction overwritten or missing correction trail
Next action: Create a reversing/correcting entry and retain audit trail

What to verify: No card secrets, passwords or unnecessary personal data in logs or support exports
Exception trigger: Sensitive data appears in logs or shared files
Customer update: Do not request sensitive credentials from customer
Next action: Restrict access and follow incident process
